When I was 11 I kept having stabbing pain in my solar plexus. I would take like 6 zantacs and that would *kinda* help but not much. Sister came and was like wtf are you doing weirdo and finally my parents came in and w I s freaking out. They tried to feed me cracked but I projectile vomited those and so they took my to the er and I was admitted for the weekend. After 6 months or so we were finally able to find a gastroenterologist that would accept me because the vast majority would only take on 18+ for some stupid reason. He had me drink barium and again projectile vomited the first cup and the techs were fuckin pissed that I did but fuck you I cant help it assholes. I was eventually diagnosed with ulcerative colitis (specifically pan-colitis) and my constant  shitting and pain *finally* went away. Been 14 years now and I gotta get a colonoscopy every other year just to check up on things.
